title: Elementary localization of enumerated purely inseparable fibre points
statement: Let f:X→S be locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], let φ:U→S be any scheme morphism, let u∈U and x:Fin n→X, and put P=X×_S U [def-pc-fibre-product] with projections p,q. Fix integers m_i≥0 and points y_{i,j}∈P. Assume that p(y_{i,j})=x_i; q(y_{i,j})=u with κ(u)→κ(y_{i,j}) [def-weil-residue-field] finite purely inseparable [def-weil-pbc-finite-purely-inseparable-extension]; each y_{i,j} is isolated in its q-fibre [def-pc-scheme-fibre]; the whole sigma family (i,j)↦y_{i,j} is injective; and these points exhaust all w with q(w)=u and p(w)=x_i. There exist an étale ψ:U'→U [def-weil-etale-morphism] and u'∈U' with ψ(u')=u, and opens V_{i,j}⊆X×_S U' with distinguished points v_{i,j}∈V_{i,j}, indexed by the SAME m_i, such that each V_{i,j}→U' is finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism]; v_{i,j} is its unique point above u'; the induced extension κ(u')→κ(v_{i,j}) is finite purely inseparable; the projection to X sends v_{i,j} to x_i; the images of all v_{i,j} in X×_S U' are distinct; and every point there over u' mapping to x_i is one of these images. The map X×_S U'→X is the first projection of the pullback of f and ψ followed by φ. No étaleness assumption on φ is used.

proof.text: The projection q:P→U is locally of finite type by base change. Enumerate the finite sigma family y by Fin N. Apply the elementary simultaneous finite-open theorem to q, u and this list, using the assumed isolatedness. This gives ψ:U′→U with ψ(u′)=u, κ(u)→κ(u′) an isomorphism, and finite opens in P×_U U′ with unique points over u′, mapping to each y and with unchanged residue field.

Use pullback pasting to identify P×_U U′ with X×_S U′ for f and ψ≫φ. Transport the opens, points and morphisms along this scheme isomorphism. Finiteness and uniqueness over u′ are preserved. The first projection sends the chosen point to y_{i,j} and then x_i.

For each transported open let a:V→P and r:V→U′ be its projections, so a≫q=r≫ψ and κ(a(v))→κ(v) is an isomorphism. Scheme.residueFieldMap_comp and residueFieldMap_congr give the commuting residue-field square after the point equalities are substituted. Transfer κ(u)→κ(y) across the point field isomorphism to obtain κ(v)/κ(u) finite purely inseparable. The square supplies the scalar tower κ(u)→κ(u′)→κ(v). Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite and IsPurelyInseparable.tower_top imply the desired properties over κ(u′). These are proved private helpers, not additional postponed statements.

Project equality of two output points to P and use hinj. For exhaustion project w to P, obtaining y_{i,j} by hex. In the pullback square P×_U U′→P, Mathlib isPullback_fiberToSpecResidueField_of_isPullback gives a cartesian square of the fibres over u′ and ψ(u′), with bottom map Spec(κ(u)→κ(u′)). This bottom map is an isomorphism by the elementary neighborhood property. Hence the map of fibres is an isomorphism by IsPullback.isIso_fst_of_isIso. The fibre inclusions are embeddings and Scheme.Hom.fiberHomeo identifies their points with the set-theoretic fibres. Thus any two points above u′ with the same projection to P coincide. Apply this to w and the distinguished point above y_{i,j}. This proves exhaustion without a tensor-spectrum enumeration.

theorem exists_elementary_localize_split_points
    {X S U : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (φ : U ⟶ S) (u : U) (n : ℕ) (x : Fin n → X) (m : Fin n → ℕ)
    (y : (i : Fin n) → Fin (m i) → ↥(pullback f φ))
    (hyx : ∀ i j, pullback.fst f φ (y i j) = x i)
    (hy : ∀ i j, ∃ (h : pullback.snd f φ (y i j) = u),
      letI := ((U.residueFieldCongr h.symm).hom ≫
        (pullback.snd f φ).residueFieldMap (y i j)).hom.toAlgebra
      Module.Finite (U.residueField u) ((pullback f φ).residueField (y i j)) ∧
        IsPurelyInseparable (U.residueField u) ((pullback f φ).residueField (y i j)))
    (hisolated : ∀ i j, IsOpen ({(pullback.snd f φ).asFiber (y i j)} :
      Set ((pullback.snd f φ).fiber ((pullback.snd f φ) (y i j)))))
    (hinj : Function.Injective (fun a : (i : Fin n) × Fin (m i) ↦ y a.1 a.2))
    (hex : ∀ (i : Fin n) (w : ↥(pullback f φ)),
      pullback.snd f φ w = u → pullback.fst f φ w = x i →
        ∃ j : Fin (m i), w = y i j) :
    ∃ (U' : Scheme.{u}) (ψ : U' ⟶ U) (u' : U'), Etale ψ ∧ ψ u' = u ∧
      ∃ (V : (i : Fin n) → Fin (m i) → (pullback f (ψ ≫ φ)).Opens)
        (v : (i : Fin n) → (j : Fin (m i)) → (V i j).toScheme),
        (∀ (i : Fin n) (j : Fin (m i)),
          IsFinite ((V i j).ι ≫ pullback.snd f (ψ ≫ φ)) ∧
          ∃ (hv : ((V i j).ι ≫ pullback.snd f (ψ ≫ φ)) (v i j) = u'),
            (∀ w : (V i j).toScheme,
              ((V i j).ι ≫ pullback.snd f (ψ ≫ φ)) w = u' → w = v i j) ∧
            (letI := ((U'.residueFieldCongr hv.symm).hom ≫
              ((V i j).ι ≫ pullback.snd f (ψ ≫ φ)).residueFieldMap (v i j)).hom.toAlgebra
             Module.Finite (U'.residueField u') ((V i j).toScheme.residueField (v i j)) ∧
               IsPurelyInseparable (U'.residueField u')
                 ((V i j).toScheme.residueField (v i j))) ∧
            ((V i j).ι ≫ pullback.fst f (ψ ≫ φ)) (v i j) = x i) ∧
        Function.Injective
          (fun a : (i : Fin n) × Fin (m i) ↦ (V a.1 a.2).ι (v a.1 a.2)) ∧
        (∀ (i : Fin n) (w : ↥(pullback f (ψ ≫ φ))),
          pullback.snd f (ψ ≫ φ) w = u' → pullback.fst f (ψ ≫ φ) w = x i →
            ∃ j : Fin (m i), w = (V i j).ι (v i j))
